title: PILLAGERS, THE PEDDLER AND WIRT DEAL HIGHER RARITY GUNS
why: The second half of the higher rarity guns, from his order of 2026-10-14. A pillager now carries the higher rarity version of his gun about one time in seven (a pillager with a Compact SMG, an Auto Rifle, a Burst Carbine or a Riot Scattergun), an elite pillager about one time in six, and the body drops exactly that gun with its higher damage. The Peddler stocks the higher version in his gun slot at about one stall in five, priced for what it is worth, and Wirt gives one in five of the guns he deals as the higher version. Each of them is decided from a number the game already draws, or from where the stall stands, so nothing new is drawn and the seeded raids are what they were. The stat card of a gun now says its rarity in its colour next to the name, and when the card compares two guns of the same model at different rarities it says which rarity it is against, with the damage figures and an UPGRADE verdict. The backpack and stash hover card of a higher gun says its rarity and the damage it adds on its damage row, without taking a new row.
now: Pillagers, the Peddler and Wirt now deal the higher rarity guns too, and the stat card names the rarity.
